utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest yet—what’s the current update on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: We’re still on track, as far as I know. I’d check in later today for the next clear update.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it, I’ll check back later today. Thanks for keeping me posted.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’m in—just send me the details for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great—I'll text you the time, place, and what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks — I’ll watch for your text.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think so, but I’d double-check the timing and who’s bringing what before heading over.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — I’ll double-check before I go.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I’m in, I just need to check what still needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great — I’ll make a quick list of what’s still needed so you can check it over.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Cleo — that’d help a lot. I’ll look it over and see what I can handle.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m ready to help—what details do you want me to check for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, just make sure the time and place are right for the repair drive. I think everything else is fine, but I might be missing something.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll double-check the time and place first, and if I spot anything else off, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Jules, I’m a bit late—what’s left to do for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries — we still need a few donations sorted and the pickup list checked. If you’ve got a minute, you can help me with the boxes out front.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can help with the boxes out front, and then I’ll check the pickup list too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam — could you help sort the donated tools and set aside anything that’s still in good shape?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll sort through them and set aside the good ones.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help keep track of that—where should I note the repair drive is happening?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Please note it for next Saturday at the community center by the school.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll note next Saturday at the community center by the school.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I’ve heard a few folks are pitching in already — if you’re heading over, I can point you to where they’re collecting supplies.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh great, thanks — I’ll swing by and spread the word to a few more neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be lovely, Quinn — the more hands we’ve got, the better. I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if anything else changes.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How’s the repair drive going, Rey? Do you need any help?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It’s going alright, thanks. I could use a hand sorting supplies if you’re free.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure, I’m free now. Where should I start sorting?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and keep folks posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I really appreciate you keeping me in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll let everyone know and check back if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll help keep the repair drive organized and welcoming. What should we tackle first?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Rosa. Maybe start with the list of repairs and who needs help first.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sounds good — I’ll start a clear priority list and note who needs help first.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Eli, I heard the repair drive’s getting a good turnout today—folks have been dropping off tools and supplies all morning. If you’re headed over, I can point you to the check-in table.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Tess. I’ll stop by the check-in table first, then I’ll drop off what I brought.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Eli—just look for the blue canopy by the community hall. They’re sorting everything there and will probably be thrilled to see what you brought.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I’m late—how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — it’s going well so far, and I’m just repeating the plan to a few folks now. We’re still on track for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Glad to hear it — I can help catch up on the plan and pitch in where needed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What’s the first thing you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. Could you help me sort the donations and check what’s still needed?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Absolutely — I can sort the donations and check the list of what’s still needed. Where should I start?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I just need your starting location and the best time you can head out, so I can keep the repair drive route tidy.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m at 14 Maple and can head out around 4:30.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help spread the word about the repair drive and connect folks who want to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That’d be great, Jules. Before we do, can you share the date, location, and what kinds of repairs people can bring?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — send me the details, and I’ll help get them out to the neighborhood groups.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. What time was that again?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It starts at 3 p.m. over by the community center. I’ll be there a little early if you want to come with me.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: 3 p.m. at the community center, got it. I’ll try to make it with you.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest yet—how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: It’s going pretty well so far—folks have been dropping off things to fix, and I’ve been lending out a few tools to keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s great to hear. I’ll keep an eye out for anyone who needs a hand while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Leo — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — could you help sort the donated items and set them by category?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can sort the donated items and set them by category. I’ll get started right away.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’m a bit worried about the timing and who’s bringing what. Can we double-check the plan before we start?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes — let’s check the timing and assign who’s bringing what now.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, let’s do that now — I’d feel better if we pin down the time and list each item before anyone heads out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive? I’m telling everyone on the block — you should come by too!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll stop by and bring a few supplies if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be amazing, Cleo — thank you! I’ll let the others know you’re bringing supplies, and we’ll be glad to see you there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I’m still confirming that. I should know the time soon, and I’ll let you know as soon as I do.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Oren — just keep me posted and I’ll work around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I can help coordinate the repair drive and keep things moving. What should we tackle first?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I’m still catching up, so could you tell me what’s already been decided and what needs doing first?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: So far, we’ve agreed to organize the repair drive and I’m helping keep it on track. First up, we should list the needed repairs, then assign who’s reaching out to neighbors and who’s gathering supplies.
